searchText: i think i've seen this before but want to re-ask. Shouldn't this be false? https://github.com/ethereum/tests/blob/e46e1db503ee2711ad02e1f5b3ea45d43e9cd8cb/EOFTests/efExample/validInvalid.json#L22 given that data is meant to be 4 bytes but what's available after the code section is only 2 bytes https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-3540.md#eof-version-1-validation-rules “data body length may be shorter than data_size for a not yet deployed container” ah i see thanks. so all test bytecodes are assumed to be undeployed containers, right? I woudn't trust a test that is not in the EEST repository, they haven't been updated since a few critical spec changes have happened. A container can be truncated only if it is a subcontainer and it is the target of a RETURNCONTRACT operation. So top level containers must be full length.
